versioning.patch: Editorial clarification that does not change meaning or identifiers.
versioning.minor: Backward-compatible addition of identifiers, descriptions, facets, questions, or endpoints.
versioning.major: Incompatible meaning or identifier change; publish explicit supersession mappings and never silently reclassify existing records.

categories.label: Disease modification
categories.description: Parent concept for intervention intended to alter T1D onset or progression.

categories.label: Functional restoration
categories.description: Parent concept for intervention intended to restore endocrine function in established T1D.

categories.label: Prevent or delay disease onset
categories.description: Delay progression from presymptomatic Stage 1 or 2 to clinical Stage 3; not prevention of autoimmunity.

categories.label: Preserve residual beta-cell function
categories.description: Preserve endogenous beta-cell function after Stage 3 diagnosis; not by itself restoration or cure.

categories.label: Replace beta cells
categories.description: Provide endocrine function using introduced beta cells or islet-like cells.

categories.label: Regenerate beta cells
categories.description: Increase endogenous beta-cell mass or function, as intended by the source.

categories.label: Modify autoimmunity or induce tolerance
categories.description: Alter immune recognition, effector activity, or tolerance; specify the stated strategy.

categories.label: Combination approach
categories.description: Intentionally combines two or more intervention components; retain each component classification.

categories.label: Donor pancreatic islets
categories.description: Primary pancreatic islets from a donor; record deceased, living, or unknown donor relationship separately.

categories.label: Stem-cell-derived islet replacement
categories.description: Differentiated endocrine or islet-like cells derived from a stem-cell source.

categories.label: Gene-edited cell therapy
categories.description: Cells with genetic modification; record target and purpose from the source.

categories.label: Encapsulated or immune-protected cell therapy
categories.description: Device, membrane, scaffold, or cell-intrinsic strategy intended to protect cells; do not infer immune isolation from the label.

categories.label: Autologous cell approach
categories.description: Cell approach using material derived from the treated individual; origin alone does not establish immune protection.

categories.label: Allogeneic cell approach
categories.description: Cell approach using material from another individual or donor.

categories.label: Immune-modulating therapy
categories.description: Pharmacologic or biologic intervention intended to alter immune activity.

categories.label: Adoptive immune-cell therapy
categories.description: Transfer of immune cells, such as regulatory T cells; immune-tolerance intent is separately recorded.

categories.label: Regenerative approach
categories.description: Intervention intended to restore endogenous beta-cell mass or function.

categories.label: Other or emerging mechanism
categories.description: Documented approach not yet represented by a more specific mechanism; preserve source wording and flag for review.

facets.label: Cell origin and donor relationship
facets.description: Distinguish source of cells from donor relationship; multiple values may apply.

values.label: Stem-cell-derived
values.description: Cells differentiated from a stated stem-cell source.

values.label: Other specified source
values.description: A source is stated but does not fit another value.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: The catalog does not establish origin.

facets.label: Genetic modification
facets.description: Presence, purpose, and target of genetic modification as explicitly reported.

values.label: None reported
values.description: No modification is stated in the reviewed metadata.

values.label: Present
values.description: Genetic modification is stated; target and purpose require source detail.

values.label: Mixed or heterogeneous
values.description: Modified and unmodified material is described.

values.label: Not applicable
values.description: No cell product to which this facet applies.

facets.label: Immune strategy
facets.description: Protection, modulation, or tolerance strategy; multiple distinct strategies may apply.

values.label: Cell-intrinsic immune evasion
values.description: Genetic or cellular strategy intended to alter immune recognition.

values.label: Encapsulation or immune isolation
values.description: Device/membrane strategy; actual immune protection must be supported by design details.

values.label: Combination
values.description: More than one strategy is intentionally used.

values.label: None reported
values.description: No strategy is reported; not proof that immune attack is absent.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: The strategy is not established by metadata.

facets.label: Systemic immunosuppression status
facets.description: Separate protocol requirement from observed exposure and model context.

values.label: Required
values.description: Protocol or product requires systemic immunosuppression.

values.label: Used
values.description: Exposure is reported, without implying it was protocol-required.

values.label: Planned
values.description: Protocol plans use; observed exposure not established.

values.label: Not required in described context
values.description: Source explicitly reports no requirement in a specified protocol or model.

values.label: Varies
values.description: Requirement/exposure differs across settings or participants.

values.label: Device or scaffold site
values.description: Implantation into a stated device/scaffold site.

values.label: Infusion
values.description: Infusion route when more specific site is not stated.

values.label: Injection
values.description: Injection route when more specific site is not stated.

facets.label: Retreatment
facets.description: Distinguish protocol possibility from repeat treatment actually received.

values.label: Repeat planned or possible
values.description: Repeat treatment is planned or permitted.

values.label: Repeat performed
values.description: Repeat treatment is reported as received.

values.label: Rescue or explant
values.description: Rescue intervention or explant is reported.

facets.label: Development stage
facets.description: Program stage as dated and stated by the source; not an evidence-strength grade.

values.label: Later-phase clinical
values.description: Later clinical study phase as stated by source.

values.label: Post-authorization or marketed
values.description: Post-authorization or marketed context in a stated jurisdiction.

facets.label: Regulatory status
facets.description: Jurisdiction-specific formal action and indication; not a proxy for efficacy or suitability.

values.label: Approved
values.description: Formal approval is documented for a specified product, use, population, and jurisdiction.

values.label: Accelerated or conditional approval
values.description: Approval pathway is explicitly qualified as such.

values.label: Not established
values.description: No regulatory status is established by the catalog metadata.

facets.label: Target population
facets.description: Source-defined disease stage, age, duration, residual function, eligibility, and other characteristics.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: Population cannot be established from metadata.

facets.label: Product and manufacturing attributes
facets.description: Cell source, differentiation, dose, device, potency, supply, and access attributes as available.

values.label: Potency attribute stated
values.description: Potency attribute or assay is stated.

values.label: Supply constraint stated
values.description: Supply or production constraint is stated.

research_questions.label: Primary question
research_questions.description: Human clinical evidence for durable insulin independence or other patient-important disease-modifying outcomes, populations/stages, follow-up, harms, dependencies, retreatment, access, and uncertainty.

research_questions.label: Insulin independence and metabolic function
research_questions.description: Source-defined insulin independence and duration with patient-important glycemic outcomes.

research_questions.label: Severe hypoglycemia
research_questions.description: Severe-event burden and affected participants with source-defined ascertainment.

research_questions.label: Endogenous insulin production
research_questions.description: Preservation, restoration, or loss of endogenous secretion and its relation to clinical outcomes.

research_questions.label: Serious harms and discontinuation
research_questions.description: Serious adverse events, deaths, discontinuation, procedures, and treatment burden.

research_questions.label: Immunosuppression dependence
research_questions.description: Clinical benefit in relation to systemic immunosuppression exposure and complications.

research_questions.label: Graft durability and retreatment
research_questions.description: Persistence, loss of function, repeat treatment, rescue, or explant.

research_questions.label: Population and stage applicability
research_questions.description: Populations, disease stages, eligibility, and limits to generalizability.

research_questions.label: Long-term evidence gaps
research_questions.description: Missing observations that prevent assessment of durability, benefit, safety, and coverage.

research_questions.label: Accessibility and implementation
research_questions.description: Eligibility reach, manufacturing, delivery, monitoring, affordability, and access constraints.

research_questions.label: Prevention or delay of Stage 3 onset
research_questions.description: Time to clinical Stage 3 diagnosis in presymptomatic populations, with burden and safety.

research_questions.label: Beta-cell preservation after diagnosis
research_questions.description: Residual beta-cell function after Stage 3 diagnosis and patient-important outcomes.

endpoints.label: Insulin independence
endpoints.description: Source-defined absence of exogenous insulin, with threshold, consecutive period, confirmation, rescue/restart rules, numerator, denominator, and analysis set.
endpoints.denominator_rule: Participants meeting the exact source definition divided by participants assessed at that time/window; retain randomized and treated denominators separately.
endpoints.timing_anchor: Randomization, intervention, infusion, or first qualifying insulin-free day as explicitly stated.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Dose reduction is not independence; independence during systemic immunosuppression is treatment-dependent; do not impose a universal threshold.

endpoints.label: Duration of insulin independence
endpoints.description: Elapsed source-defined time during which insulin-independence criteria remain satisfied.
endpoints.denominator_rule: Report participants at risk and achieving independence; preserve censoring and incomplete follow-up.
endpoints.timing_anchor: First qualifying insulin-free day and last confirmed independent assessment.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Follow-up duration is not insulin-free duration; maximum follow-up does not apply to the entire cohort.

endpoints.label: Severe hypoglycemic events
endpoints.description: Events meeting the source's severity and ascertainment definition.
units: participants with one or more events
endpoints.denominator_rule: Keep total recurrent events separate from distinct affected participants and time at risk.
endpoints.timing_anchor: Source-defined event observation period, with baseline history stated separately.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Event count cannot be substituted for affected participant count; CGM time below range is not equivalent.

endpoints.label: HbA1c
endpoints.description: Source-reported glycated hemoglobin value or change, with assay and summary method.
endpoints.denominator_rule: Number assessed for HbA1c at the specified timepoint; retain missingness and analysis set.
endpoints.timing_anchor: Collection time/window relative to randomization or intervention.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Not interchangeable with CGM; a composite threshold does not establish individual values or an unstated assessment window.

endpoints.label: CGM-derived measures
endpoints.description: Source-defined CGM metric, including target range, valid wear, device, and aggregation window.
endpoints.denominator_rule: Participants meeting the source's CGM data sufficiency rule; readings are not participants.
endpoints.timing_anchor: CGM collection window and baseline/follow-up dates.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Different ranges/windows and pooled-reading summaries are not directly comparable; CGM does not equal severe events or HbA1c.

endpoints.label: C-peptide and endogenous secretion
endpoints.description: Fasting or stimulated C-peptide/secretion measure with assay, stimulation, metric, threshold, and detection limit.
endpoints.denominator_rule: Participants with the specified assay at the specified time; dichotomous thresholds need participant numerator and denominator.
endpoints.timing_anchor: Time from diagnosis and intervention; baseline and each assessment.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: A surrogate; do not infer clinical restoration, insulin independence, or cure.

endpoints.label: Exogenous insulin requirements
endpoints.description: Source-defined insulin dose/regimen with body weight and calculation method where reported.
endpoints.denominator_rule: Participants with dose data for the timepoint; report summary statistic and dispersion.
endpoints.timing_anchor: Dose averaging window and relation to intervention.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Dose reduction is not independence; changes may reflect co-interventions or management.

endpoints.label: Graft survival and function
endpoints.description: Source-defined persistence, viability, engraftment, endocrine function, or failure; retain each concept separately.
endpoints.denominator_rule: State whether denominator is participant, graft, device, or tissue; do not interchange.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Persistence is not adequate function or clinical benefit; sentinel tissue may not represent all grafts.

endpoints.label: Serious adverse events and discontinuation
endpoints.description: Seriousness/type and source-attributed status of adverse events, with treatment interruption, discontinuation, explant, hospitalization, and death recorded separately.
endpoints.denominator_rule: Report recurrent event counts separately from participants with one or more events and number exposed.
endpoints.timing_anchor: Exposure period, event onset, discontinuation, and post-treatment surveillance.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Temporal association is not causation; small or short studies cannot rule out rare/late harms.

endpoints.label: Immunosuppression exposure and complications
endpoints.description: Systemic agents/regimens, actual exposure, changes, cessation, and separately defined complications.
endpoints.denominator_rule: Complication counts use affected participants and event counts separately with exposure window/denominator.
endpoints.timing_anchor: Cell treatment/infusion and each immunosuppression exposure period.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Required, planned, and received therapy are distinct; do not attribute harms unless source does.

endpoints.label: Quality of life and treatment burden
endpoints.description: Patient-reported quality-of-life, burden, fear, function, or preference using source-identified instrument/domain.
endpoints.denominator_rule: Number of eligible respondents analyzed; state missing questionnaires and respondent type.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Different instruments are not interchangeable; response bias and missingness matter.

endpoints.label: Long-term durability and safety
endpoints.description: Longitudinal patient-important benefit, graft/therapy function, retreatment, and delayed harm, each preserved as its own measure.
endpoints.denominator_rule: Report each constituent endpoint's own analysis denominator and participants observed at each horizon.
endpoints.timing_anchor: Intervention or source-defined time origin, with multi-year horizon stated.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Not a single endpoint; 12 months is a reporting expectation, not a durability threshold; longest follow-up does not apply to all.

endpoints.label: Stage 3 onset delay
endpoints.description: Time from defined Stage 1/2 baseline to source-defined, adjudicated clinical Stage 3 diagnosis.
endpoints.denominator_rule: Report progression participants and time-to-event analysis set; preserve censoring and uncertainty.
endpoints.timing_anchor: Date of qualifying Stage 1/2 baseline to diagnosis.
endpoints.interpretation_hazards: Delay is not prevention of autoimmunity, reversal, or post-diagnosis preservation.

relationships.description: Prevention/delay intent is a disease-modification intent.
Post-diagnosis preservation intent is a disease-modification intent.
Cell replacement is a functional-restoration intent.
Beta-cell regeneration is a functional-restoration intent.
Donor islets may be genetically edited.
Stem-cell-derived islets may be genetically edited.
Donor islets may be delivered in an encapsulation or protection strategy.
Stem-cell-derived islets may be delivered in an encapsulation or protection strategy.
Combination intent may include immune modulation alongside another intervention.
Adoptive immune-cell transfer may also be immune-modulating.
